title: Nature immersion
summary: Intentional time in green or blue space—parks, trails, beaches, gardens—away from dense screens and routers, logged as multi-block outdoor recovery.

sections.heading: Why place matters
sections.body: Parks, trails, beaches, and gardens combine natural surfaces, lower artificial EMF density than many offices, and real daylight. Unhurried outdoor time supports both Magnetism and Light pillars without requiring a gadget. Nature immersion is the habit for longer outdoor blocks that are not specifically barefoot-only grounding sessions.

sections.heading: What counts as immersion
sections.body: Intentional green or blue space: a walk under trees, time by water, a garden hour, a trail—away from constant screen checking. Sitting on a park bench with the phone in airplane mode counts more than a stressed errand dash through a parking lot. The point is place and attention, not athletic performance.

sections.heading: Practical habit
sections.body: Schedule a block you will actually keep—often afternoon or anytime. Leave the phone on airplane mode or in a pocket when you want a cleaner field hour. Stack with barefoot contact on soil when the surface is safe. Duration logs in 15-minute blocks up to the cap; consistency beats occasional epic hikes you never repeat.

sections.heading: Where Dr. Jack Kruse’s teaching is specific
sections.body: Kruse’s place teaching binds latitude, geology, light, and low artificial fields into one outdoor story. Nature time in his stack is not “wellness vibes”—it is recovery from indoor nnEMF and artificial light while restoring native magnetic and photonic inputs. Treat strong disease claims from forum place stories as framework; treat getting outside as the solid habit.

sections.heading: What is solid, what is framework
sections.body: Solid ground: outdoor green/blue space usually means more daylight, more movement, and distance from dense indoor RF; population studies associate nature access with stress and attention benefits. Framework: that a park hour uniquely “recharges” mitochondrial magnetism in a way this app measures. Use nature immersion as behavioral place hygiene.

sections.heading: How to use it here
sections.body: Log Nature immersion for outdoor green/blue blocks. Use Grounding when skin-to-earth is the main act; use Exercise when the session is primarily walking, bands, or rebounding. Pair with nnEMF reduction blocks when you deliberately keep radios off outdoors. Educational only.
